76571-death-of-a-hero.creator: Unknown
76571-death-of-a-hero.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. arently, not a novel at all. Certain conventions of form and method in the novel have been erected, I gather, into immutable laws, and are looked upon with quite superstitious reverence. They are entirely disregarded here. To me the excuse for the novel is that one can do any damn thing one pleases.

arxiv-1706-01483.title: Autoignition of Methyl Valerate at Low to Intermediate Temperatures and Elevated Pressures in a Rapid Compression Machine
arxiv-1706-01483.creator: Bryan W. Weber, Justin Bunnell, Kamal Kumar, Chih-Jen Sung
arxiv-1706-01483.description: Abstract Methyl valerate ( C 6 ​ H 12 ​ O 2 \text{C}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{6}}}\text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{12}}}\text{O}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} , methyl pentanoate) is a methyl ester and a relevant surrogate component for biodiesel. In this work, we present ignition delays of methyl valerate measured using a rapid compression machine at a range of engine-relevant temperature, pressure, and equivalence ratio conditions.

arxiv-2112-04677.title: A Note on Comparison of F -measures
arxiv-2112-04677.creator: Wei Ju, Wenxin Jiang
arxiv-2112-04677.description: Abstract We comment on a recent TKDE paper [ 1 ] “Linear Approximation of F -measure for the Performance Evaluation of Classification Algorithms on Imbalanced Data Sets”, and make two improvements related to comparison of F -measures for two prediction rules. I Introduction F-measure is a popular performance measure for classification algorithms, which compromises precision and recall.

arxiv-2205-10785.title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence – from Principles to Practice
arxiv-2205-10785.creator: Virginia Dignum
arxiv-2205-10785.description: Abstract The impact of Artificial Intelligence does not depend only on fundamental research and technological developments, but for a large part on how these systems are introduced into society and used in everyday situations. AI is changing the way we work, live and solve challenges but concerns about fairness, transparency or privacy are also growing.

arxiv-2209-11728.title: Posterior Probabilities: Nonmonotonicity, Asymptotic Rates, Log-concavity, and Turán’s Inequality Previous version: July 2020 (Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Center for Rationality DP-736).
arxiv-2209-11728.creator: Sergiu Hart a label=e1]hart@huji.ac.illabel=u1], Yosef Rinott b label=e3]yosef.rinott@mail.huji.ac.illabel=u1]
arxiv-2209-11728.description: Abstract In the standard Bayesian framework data are assumed to be generated by a distribution parametrized by θ \theta in a parameter space Θ \Theta , over which a prior distribution π \pi is given. A Bayesian statistician quantifies the belief that the true parameter is θ 0 \theta_{0} in Θ \Theta by its posterior probability given the observed data.

arxiv-2307-01296.title: Unruh entropy of Schwarzschild black hole
arxiv-2307-01296.creator: M. Teslyk, L. Bravina, E. Zabrodin, O. Teslyk
arxiv-2307-01296.description: Abstract The entropy produced by the Unruh radiation is estimated and compared to the entropy of a Schwarzschild black hole. We simulate a spherical system of mass M M by set of Unruh horizons and estimate the total entropy of the outgoing radiation. Dependence on mass and spin of the emitted particles is taken into account.

arxiv-2309-16258.title: ⟨ \langle QonFusion ⟩ \rangle - Quantum Approaches to Gaussian Random Variables: Applications in Stable Diffusion and Brownian Motion.
arxiv-2309-16258.creator: Shlomo Kashani Φ \Phi
arxiv-2309-16258.description: Abstract In the present study, we delineate a strategy focused on non-parametric quantum circuits for the generation of Gaussian random variables (GRVs). This quantum-centric approach serves as a substitute for conventional pseudorandom number generators (PRNGs), such as the torch.rand function in PyTorch.

arxiv-2401-06483.title: Resonant Solitary States in Complex Networks
arxiv-2401-06483.creator: Jakob Niehues, Serhiy Yanchuk, Rico Berner, Jürgen Kurths, Frank Hellmann, Mehrnaz Anvari
arxiv-2401-06483.description: Abstract Partially synchronized solitary states occur frequently when a synchronized system of networked oscillators with inertia is perturbed locally. Several asymptotic states of different frequencies can coexist at the same node. Here, we reveal the mechanism behind this multistability: additional solitary frequencies arise from the coupling between network modes and the solitary oscillator’s frequency, leading to significant energy transfer.

arxiv-2402-07766.title: On the effect of the luni-solar gravitational attraction on trees
arxiv-2402-07766.creator: Le Mouël Jean-Louis, Gibert Dominique, Boulé Jean-Baptiste, Zuddas Pierpaolo, de Bremond d’Ars Jean, Courtillot Vincent, Lopes Fernando, Gèze Marc, Maineult Alexis
arxiv-2402-07766.description: Abstract In this study, we revisit an old series of continuous electrical measurements made in 2003 on a standing Poplar tree in the village of Remungol, France ( cf. ? )), through the lens of a more refined signal analysis (Singular Spectrum Analysis).

arxiv-2405-10189.title: On fusing matrices associated with conformal boundary conditions
arxiv-2405-10189.creator: Anatoly Konechny, and Vasileios Vergioglou
arxiv-2405-10189.description: Abstract In the context of rational conformal field theories (RCFT) we look at the fusing matrices that arise when a topological defect is attached to a conformal boundary condition. We call such junctions open topological defects. One type of fusing matrices arises when two open defects fuse while another arises when an open defect passes through a boundary operator.

arxiv-2410-07240.title: Evaluating internal and external dissonance of belief dynamics in social systems
arxiv-2410-07240.creator: Joshua T. S. Hewson, Ke Fang
arxiv-2410-07240.description: Abstract Keywords: Belief dynamics, Belief network, Social network, Agent-based model Extended Abstract Belief dynamics are central to human society. Individuals depend on accurate beliefs to engage in appropriate behaviors (Hemmer et al., 2022; Yon et al., 2020), such as deciding which college or which job position to apply for.

arxiv-2508-04643.title: Experimental device-independent certification of indefinite causal order
arxiv-2508-04643.creator: Dengke Qu, Quan Lin, Lei Xiao, Xiang Zhan, Peng Xue
arxiv-2508-04643.description: Abstract Understanding the physical world fundamentally relies on the assumption that events are temporally ordered, with past events serving as causes for future ones. However, quantum mechanics permits events to occur in a superposition of causal orders, providing new types of quantum resources for quantum information tasks.

arxiv-2511-22384.title: Skating System Unveiled: Exploring Preference Aggregation in Ballroom Tournaments
arxiv-2511-22384.creator: Laryssa Horn, Paul Nüsken, Jörg Rothe, Tessa Seeger
arxiv-2511-22384.description: Abstract The Skating System , which originated from the scrutineering system in dance sport tournaments, can be formulated as a voting system: We introduce and formalize the Skating System Single ( SkS , for short), a new voting system embedded into the framework of computational social choice.

arxiv-2512-03236.title: Real-Time Adaptive Feedback Control of a Supersonic Dual-Stream Jet
arxiv-2512-03236.creator: Melissa Yeung, Yiyang Sun
arxiv-2512-03236.description: Abstract Adaptive control is applied to a supersonic dual-stream jet flow comprised of Mach 1.6 core and Mach 1.0 bypass streams that mix to form a supersonic shear layer. The vortices shed are the source of a high-frequency tone that persists throughout the flow.

pmc-10719999.creator: Julia
pmc-10719999.description: The amount of polluting gases released into the atmosphere has grown drastically. Among them, it is possible to cite the release of CO2 and CO gases on a large scale as one of the products of the complete and incomplete combustion of petroleum-derived fuels.

pmc-11313394.title: Optimization of the Method for Isolating Bacterial DNA from the Aboveground Part of Lettuce
pmc-11313394.creator: Magdalena Krupka, Agnieszka I. Piotrowicz-Cieślak
pmc-11313394.description: Developing an effective method for isolating bacterial genetic material from plants is a relatively challenging task and often does not yield adequately prepared material for further analyses. Previous studies often overlook connections, primarily focusing on laboratory investigations. With advancements in high-throughput sequencing techniques, we can now revisit and delve deeper into these interactions.

pmc-11336355.title: Quantifying physical activity, physical education and active travel in children and adolescents with visual Impairments
pmc-11336355.creator: Lisa Flynn, Kristina Millar, Sarahjane Belton, Noel O'Connor, Sarah Meegan, Una Britton, Stephen Behan
pmc-11336355.description: BackgroundMeeting the physical activity (PA) guidelines for children, as set out by the World Health Organisation (WHO), has a range of physical and mental health benefits. For children who are blind or vision impaired (BVI), additional benefits include social inclusion and reduced falls risk.

pmc-11380822.title: An investigation into the chiropractic practice and communication of routine, repetitive radiographic imaging for the location of postural misalignments
pmc-11380822.creator: Brogan Williams, Luke Gichard, David Johnson, Matthew Louis
pmc-11380822.description: Many chiropractors use radiological imaging, particularly X-rays, to locate and diagnose the cause of their patients’ pain. However, this approach is fundamentally flawed because X-rays provide anatomical information but not functional insights. Pain, tissue damage, and injury do not always correlate directly with X-ray appearances.

pmc-12469708.title: De Novo Transcriptome Sequencing and Profiling of Ovarian Development of Argas persicus Along the Trophogonic Cycle
pmc-12469708.creator: Fen Yan, Deyong Duan, Jinzhu Meng, Tianyin Cheng, Fabrizio Lombardo
pmc-12469708.description: Background: Argas persicus is a hematophagous ectoparasite of poultry and is the vector of several agents infectious to poultry. This study aims to explore the key genes affecting the ovarian development of A. persicus. Methods: RNA-seq was performed on the ovaries of A. persicus before blood-feeding, on the day of engorgement, and 6 days post-engorgement.

pmc-12757278.title: Lipocalin-2 modulates recipients alloimmune responses to the murine kidney transplants
pmc-12757278.creator: Anna Maria Pfefferkorn, Raphaela Fritsche-Guenther, Angelika Kusch, Hubert Schwelberger, Shiqian Liu, Robert Klopfleisch, Yuhuan Li, Rusan Catar, Shaokun Liu, Felix Aigner, Johann Pratschke, Igor Maximilian Sauer, Muhammad Imtiaz Ashraf
pmc-12757278.description: BackgroundLipocalin-2 (Lcn2) is a sensitive early marker for acute kidney injury, delayed graft function and acute rejection of kidney transplants. We previously showed the renoprotective effect of recombinant Lcn2:Siderophore: Fe3+ (rLcn2) in a mouse kidney transplantation (KTx) model. Here, we investigate the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying these effects.

pmc-13092822.title: Paediatric Sternoclavicular Joint Pseudodislocation Fixation Technique
pmc-13092822.creator: Akib M Khan, Megan E Cain, Kemble K Wang
pmc-13092822.description: Background:Posterior sternoclavicular joint (SCJ) injuries in children are rare and frequently misdiagnosed. Due to the anatomy of the immature medial clavicle, many of these injuries are Salter-Harris type I/II physeal fractures rather than true joint dislocations—termed pseudodislocations. These injuries require careful diagnosis and tailored management to ensure safe and functional outcomes.

pmc-13429639.title: Optimizing joint engagement in autism: considering toddler developmental abilities and caregiver stress
pmc-13429639.creator: Sydney Seese, Angelina Matar, Lily Mendes, Amanda Gulsrud, Connie Kasari
pmc-13429639.description: IntroductionPlay interactions between caregivers and their toddlers provide a critical context for the emergence of joint engagement, a state that supports early learning andsocial communication. Differences in toddler's developmental characteristics and caregiver experiences may influence how joint engagement is established during these interactions.

pmc-13486315.title: Alcohol policy modelling studies require realistic assumptions—authors’ reply
pmc-13486315.creator: Daniela Correia, Maria Neufeld, Carina Ferreira-Borges, Beatrice Lauby-Secretan, Jürgen Rehm
pmc-13486315.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). nce public health is crucial. Our modelling builds directly on IARC Handbook 20B (3; see also4), a multi-year undertaking involving more than 25 international experts. The primary aim of the Handbook was to establish causality between alcohol policies and changes in consumption based on rigorous and transparent criteria, rather than to identify the most realistic real-world effect size for each policy. In estimating the impact on cancer incidence we did not seek to revisit the Handbook's deliberations, but relied on its conclusions.

pmc-13537855.title: A simple and powerful test of vaccine waning
pmc-13537855.creator: Gellért Perényi, Matias Janvin, Mats J Stensrud
pmc-13537855.description: Determining whether vaccine efficacy wanes is important for individual and public decision making. Yet, quantification of waning is a subtle task. The classical approaches cannot be interpreted as measures of declining efficacy unless we impose unreasonable assumptions. Recently, formal causal estimands designed to quantify vaccine waning have been proposed.

pmc-13626526.title: Epistemic injustice in climate health research
pmc-13626526.creator: Verina Wild, Anthony Capon, Jan-Christoph Heilinger, Cristian Timmermann, Mujahid Torwali, Jakelin Troy
pmc-13626526.description: f knowledge production, validation and exchange.4 The harmful effects of these injustices are well documented, for instance in gender medicine, health research from low- and middle-income countries or in relation to traditional medicine.5,6 The concept of epistemic injustice is useful in understanding the structural origin and extent of imbalances in knowledge production.
